entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings born of the infinite void between realities whose one goal is to consume.

entities.name: Roil
entities.description: A Zendikari phenomenon that, in theory, should have stilled with the death of the Eldrazi but did not.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan imprisoned in the moon, the only vault great enough to hold her.

entities.name: Koma
entities.description: A serpent-like being imprisoned by the gods who feared he would devour the Cosmos; some call him a monster, others a god.

entities.name: Fynn
entities.description: A speaker (Fynn, the Fangbearer) who challenges Koma to reclaim what he lost.

entities.name: Arahbo
entities.description: A feline from whom all cats of the Multiverse are said to trace their lineage; his roar calls the hunt.

entities.name: Lars
entities.description: A fisherman who spares fish for hungry cats.

entities.name: Krek
entities.description: A daysquad captain.

entities.name: Basri Ket
entities.description: A person who greets a returning little hero.

entities.name: Zahr
entities.description: A climber who wept with relief when a felidar's horns appeared.

entities.name: Sir Brilbury
entities.description: A knight whose fear of heights was outmatched by his sense of duty.

entities.name: Calydd
entities.description: A kithkin farmer.

entities.name: Trigori
entities.description: An Azorius senator.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of her grappling kraken.

entities.name: Kari Zev
entities.description: A skyship captain who says a pirate's nature is to be free of law.

entities.name: Markos
entities.description: A sailor who realized he was not the first to try sailing out of the Underworld.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker necromancer who speaks of demonic pacts, the dark realms and her power.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker who speaks of taming storms and whose storm detected infiltrating planeswalkers.

entities.name: Norf
entities.description: A competitor determined to win the arm-wrestling contest.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A munitions master.

entities.name: Krenko
entities.description: A goblin whose protection racket gets stall owners to pay.

entities.name: Ikko
entities.description: A goblin who unintentionally started a riot.

entities.name: Mino
entities.description: A person whose plan went awry when a cerberus head woke.

entities.name: Vizrik
entities.description: A person inspired by a cathar's attire.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer and planeswalker able to melt solid rock.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker who comments on predators and herbivores.

entities.name: Elenda
entities.description: A figure (Elenda, Saint of Dusk) who tells another they learned nothing in her absence.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: A god who placed the sun into the Champion's hand.

entities.name: The Champion
entities.description: A hero who reached for a stone while Heliod placed the sun in her hand.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker and leonin once rejected by his pride, now revered as healer and friend.

entities.name: Teysa
entities.description: A figure who says thinking only one step ahead means falling behind.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who talks about the hedrons and the Eldrazi with Ugin.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker dragon who says the hedrons show the Eldrazi can be imprisoned.

entities.name: Malacan
entities.description: A Vantress exile.

entities.name: Beckett Brass
entities.description: An admiral whose sayings include a rallying line for the Brazen Coalition.

entities.name: Mort the Philosopher
entities.description: A philosopher who died mid-sentence.

entities.name: Odric
entities.description: A monster-fighter doomed by a vampire's curse to become a monster himself.

entities.name: Tinybones
entities.description: A thief whose heist was the greatest of all time.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: A Phyrexian who destroyed Mishra.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: A man whose desperation to destroy his brother let Gix destroy him instead.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: A once-mortal ogre who devoured his demonic patron and transcended mortality.

entities.name: Koth of the Hammer
entities.description: A speaker who says as long as there is will to fight there are weapons.

entities.name: Raff Slugeater
entities.description: A goblin shortcutter.

entities.name: Syr Carah
entities.description: A knight called the Bold.

entities.name: Tiana
entities.description: A gunner who credits Serra and tuning cannons.

entities.name: Giada
entities.description: A figure who is New Capenna's greatest hope.

entities.name: Muldrotha
entities.description: A being (Muldrotha, the Gravetide) described by Multani as his child.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: A being who says his child grew from rot and ruin yet bloomed.

entities.name: Ruby
entities.description: A girl (Ruby, Daring Tracker) set on finding her brother.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: A dragon, Ravnica's sharpest mind and biggest ego, who compares storms to dragons.

entities.name: Zimone
entities.description: A student who thinks in twelve dimensions.

entities.name: Surrak
entities.description: A hunter who feels the greatest honor is to feed Atarka.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: A warleader on the frontlines of war in contrast with Razia.

entities.name: Razia
entities.description: An aloof and untouchable figure compared to Aurelia.

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: A planeswalker whose smite pierces Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor pierced by light, her nightmare made flesh.

entities.name: Lyra Dawnbringer
entities.description: An angel who says martyrs are not made of villains.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A planeswalker who once wielded a god's power and hubris and now risks everything to fix his mistakes.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A praetor of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Nokar
entities.description: A priest of Sheoldred.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A former Tah-crop initiate urging an exodus from the city.

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: The person Samut urges to gather others and leave.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: An archaeologist warning of canyon excavation.

entities.name: Pero
entities.description: A man who called on a memory of a lightning storm in desperation.

entities.name: Angrath
entities.description: A planeswalker who says gold without freedom is lead.

entities.name: Tamina
entities.description: A district guide.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A pyromancer who says the best way to learn from a pyromancy book is to burn it.

entities.name: Gadwick
entities.description: A wizened figure who speaks of knowing everything.

entities.name: Gisa
entities.description: A ghoulcaller.

entities.name: Drana
entities.description: A Kalastria bloodchief.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who says every choice alters the path of fate.

entities.name: Helle
entities.description: A young valkyrie who joined the honored host after one thousand tales of her ancestors.

entities.name: Querana
entities.description: A fighter who held a bridge for hours against a horde.

entities.name: Selis
entities.description: A fighter whose courage and shield crumbled.

entities.name: Syr Ameril
entities.description: A knight who pictured Castle Ardenvale while facing a blaze.

entities.name: Lazlo
entities.description: A man stabbed in the back who vows to find the culprits.

entities.name: Conyan the Great
entities.description: A warrior who awoke in a stone body after dying.

entities.name: Slibbo
entities.description: A creature tired of Korvold's library rules.

entities.name: Korvold
entities.description: A dragon with draconian library rules.

entities.name: Gnorl
entities.description: A goblin who dreamed of eating a dragon.

entities.name: Vurg
entities.description: A goblin who dreamed of eating a dragon.

entities.name: Pashin
entities.description: A would-be skyknight who must survive his first flight.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: A dragon whom hunters honor by feeding.

entities.name: Ghalta
entities.description: A primeval creature, the predator's appetite.

entities.name: Lathliss
entities.description: A dragon queen said to keep the heart of the old dragon queen in a jewel.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane where the Roil, Eldrazi and floating ruins are found.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: A plane where gladiatorial stadiums echo with grinding metal and the machine gospel is spread.

entities.name: Ikoria
entities.description: A plane where crystals glow near monsters and creatures constantly evolve.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: A plane where valkyries and giants live.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane where Niv-Mizzet lives and planeswalkers infiltrated.

entities.name: Skemfar
entities.description: A realm of the elves.

entities.name: Castle Ardenvale
entities.description: A castle pictured by Syr Ameril as home.

entities.name: Malakir
entities.description: A city of vampires.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: Bogs where life returned and vampires returned to feed.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: A realm whose host young valkyries join.

entities.name: Setessa
entities.description: A polis protected by four warrior factions named for animals.

entities.name: Three Tree City
entities.description: A city celebrated in the Valley Gazetteer.

entities.name: Brazen Coalition
entities.description: A coalition described by Beckett Brass as a firecannon pointed at enemies.

entities.name: Dusk Legion
entities.description: Vampires who undertake Blood Fasts.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Beings of New Phyrexia who seek to perfect all.

events.summary: The gods imprison Koma, fearing he would devour the Cosmos.
events.quote: The gods imprisoned Koma, fearing he would eventually devour the Cosmos itself.

events.summary: Emrakul is imprisoned in the moon.
events.quote: Only one vault was great enough to hold Emrakul.

events.summary: Mishra's desperation to destroy his brother allows Gix to destroy him.
events.quote: In Mishra's desperation to destroy his brother, he allowed Gix to destroy him instead.

events.summary: Odric resists a vampire's curse but is doomed to become a monster.
events.quote: Odric resisted the vampire's curse with all his strength.

events.summary: Hidetsugu devours his demonic patron and transcends mortality.
events.quote: Hidetsugu devoured his demonic patron and transcended mortality in a fit of rage.

events.summary: Elesh Norn screams as light pierces her.
events.quote: Elesh Norn screamed as the light pierced her.

events.summary: Fynn challenges Koma to a rematch.
events.quote: Come, Koma, and reclaim what you lost!

events.summary: Ral's storm detects planeswalkers infiltrating Ravnica.
events.quote: Planeswalkers were infiltrating Ravnica.

events.summary: Helle takes her place among the honored host after learning one thousand tales.
events.quote: she'd finally taken her place among the honored host.

events.summary: Zahr weeps with relief when he sees the felidar's horns.
events.quote: Zahr wept with relief when he saw the felidar's horns appear.

events.summary: Querana holds a bridge for hours against a horde.
events.quote: Querana held the bridge for hours

events.summary: Syr Ameril pictures Castle Ardenvale as a blaze approaches.
events.quote: Syr Ameril closed her eyes and pictured Castle Ardenvale

events.summary: Ruby sets out to find her brother.
events.quote: would stop her from finding her brother.

events.summary: Gnorl and Vurg dream of being the first goblins to eat a dragon.
events.quote: they were going to be the first goblins to eat a dragon.

events.summary: Conyan the Great awakens in a body of stone after dying.
events.quote: he snapped awake in a body of stone

events.summary: The Roil does not stop after the Eldrazi die.
events.quote: the death of the Eldrazi should have stilled the Roil. It did not.

events.summary: Teferi resolves to risk everything to fix his mistakes.
events.quote: To fix his mistakes, he would risk everything.

events.summary: Vampires return to the bogs of Bala Ged to feed on returned life.
events.quote: As life returned to the bogs of Bala Ged, the vampires returned to feed upon it.

events.summary: Bloodchiefs are annihilated in a fight between the free and enthralled, leaving young vampires around Malakir.
events.quote: With the bloodchiefs annihilated in the fight between the free and enthralled

events.summary: Slibbo grows tired of Korvold's library rules.
events.quote: Slibbo was tired of following Korvold's draconian library rules.

events.summary: Ugin tells Jace the hedrons show the Eldrazi can be imprisoned; Jace questions how that worked last time.
events.quote: The Eldrazi can be imprisoned.

relations.quote: he allowed Gix to destroy him instead.

relations.note: Nokar is a priest of Sheoldred.

relations.quote: My child grew from rot and ruin, yet she bloomed.

relations.note: Samut urges Djeru to gather others and flee the city.
relations.quote: We have to get out of the city, Djeru.
